comparison: tirzepatide vs subcutaneous semaglutide (weight loss, obesity)

summary_of_findings.comments: Indirect (no head-to-head); imprecision binding; CrI conservative.
No head-to-head CV trial; weight loss is NOT a validated CV surrogate -> no inference permitted.
Tirzepatide more nausea; both GI-dominant; placebo-anchored.
